name: a document forwarded for a price quote is NOT a handoff
why: GUARDS #11, the Abeer bug. We routinely forward a document to a translator just to get a price. Reading that as a handoff invents work that never started.

new_messages.text: How much would you charge for this one? Just need a price before I quote the client.

expect.why_empty: the only document discussed is a price check for work that is not in_flight
